scope: One saved design, covering its mapped visible board roots at matching native export dimensions. Hidden component previews, other files, platforms and arbitrary zoom levels are outside this measurement.
availability: This summary contains numeric measurements and source record hashes. Original design files, reference images, screenshot candidates and local capture records are not distributed.

methods.referenceBackdrop: Reference alpha composited onto opaque white before measurement.
methods.geometry: Matching native export and browser screenshot bounds, without alignment or scaling.
methods.strictRgb: A pixel matches only when all three 8-bit RGB channels are equal.

tolerant.meaning: Threshold controls color tolerance. Antialiasing differences remain included.

methods.aggregation: Pixel counts pooled for area weighted percentages and RGB errors. Frame means and medians are reported separately.

ssim.aggregation: Frame similarity values summarized with an equal frame mean, median and minimum.

methods.independentRgbAudit: Retained stage reports include Pillow recomputation of strict RGB counts and absolute and squared channel error sums for every measured region. Tolerant counts use pixelmatch and were not independently reimplemented.
methods.captureVariation: Repeated captures can differ slightly despite identical HTML. Use paired capture results for changes attributed to an experiment.

glyphBaselineRounding.capturePolicy: Paired fresh captures. These are separate from the frozen stage snapshots.
glyphBaselineRounding.mutation: Round only the outlined glyph local y translation with Math.round. Glyph paths, x positions, scale, paints and source data are unchanged.

analyticPrimitiveSubstitution.capturePolicy: Paired fresh captures. These are separate from the frozen stage snapshots.
analyticPrimitiveSubstitution.mutation: Replace eligible fill-only cached shapes with analytic primitives in diagnostic copies. Before captures already include the production glyph baseline correction.
